name: University of Roehampton London
description: Roehampton has moved up two places in the Complete University Guide 2022 and is now the top-ranked London post-1992 university. Roehampton’s biggest improvement is in the Student Satisfaction measure, moving up 13 places, the second consecutive year it has seen a significant improvement in this measure. A range of subjects are performed well, featuring in the top two quartiles in the country on several measures.  Timestamps Updated
